sentence: HTTPConnection only reads the scope; Request.stream receives body messages from the server and Request.send_push_promise sends a message.

WebSocket.send and accept send ASGI messages to the client, and receive takes messages from the server.
The functions examine objects and exception groups in the code of the caller.
The classes are data containers that the caller keeps.

Response.__call__ sends the response start and body messages through the ASGI send callable.
